% Dialect sketch and future golden input. Invented person and invented design
% — no data, text, or design values from any private document.
% Preamble syntax is NOT final: this file is where M1 grammar decisions get
% argued. Body markup is the stable LaTeX-shaped subset.
% M3 target: everything a one-page designed document needs — fonts, design
% tokens, palette, typed commands, layout assertions, PDF metadata.

\documentclass[paper=a4, fontsize=11pt]{resume}

\fonts{
  dir = "fonts",
  body = "Source Serif Pro",
  sans = "Open Sans",
}

% Design tokens: one rubber step, and the two spacings derived from it.
\tokens{
  step  = 1.3ex plus 0.5ex minus 0.25ex,
  wide  = 1.5 * step,
  close = 0.6 * step,
}

\palette{
  primary = #2F5D50,
  ink     = #262A2E,
  muted   = #5E6670,
}

\page{
    size = a4,
    vmargin = 18mm,
    hmargin = 22mm,
}

\runninghead{\textsc{Alex Doe} \hfill \pagenumber}

\pdfmeta{
  author = "Alex Doe",
  title  = "Alex Doe — Curriculum",
}

% Layout invariants: violation fails the build. This replaces log-grepping.
% The one-page bound, the ink-in-area frame, and the x-height floor are the
% resume class's own contract now; what stays declared is what the class
% does not imply.
\assert{ fonts.all_embedded }

% Typed command: named, typed parameters; optional marked with ?.
\define \entry(when: text, what: text, where: text, note?: text) {
  \block[before = wide]{
    \muted{\when}\quad \textbf{\what}, \where
    \ifgiven{\note}{\par \textit{\note}}
  }
}

\begin{document}

{\sans\bfseries\LARGE \primary{Alex Doe}}\\[close]
\muted{alex@example.org \middot example.org}

\section*{Work}

\entry{1996 to now}{Head Gardener}{Example Corp}[Orchards]
\begin{itemize}
  \item Grew a slow hedge 10\% faster and kept it trim.
  \item Pruned more branches than were planted, on purpose, twice.
\end{itemize}

\entry{1989 to 1996}{Gardener}{Widgets Ltd}
\begin{itemize}
  \item Planted bulbs; measured them; planted better bulbs.
\end{itemize}

\section*{Study}

\entry{1985 to 1989}{BA, Medieval History}{Example University}

\end{document}
